svg.text: WF-017 - No-timeout wait for a missing ABORT ACK
Cache line state and local locks
Independent line progress when resources allow

A pre-COMMIT error sends ABORT to each targeted holder. Hart 0 ACKs and releases its local line lock while preserving S; hart 1 does not ACK and retains its old state/lock. The CCU keeps the transaction slot and line lock; directory and requester grant remain unchanged. No timeout: reset is the only recovery. Logical aliases, not finalized RTL ports; spacing is illustrative, not a latency bound.
